  <div class="eac-body lc-stripe-wrapper-text"><h2><strong>How does the Conference work?</strong></h2>

<p>Europeans can share ideas via the <a href="https://futureu.europa.eu/?locale=en" target="_blank" class=" eac-external-link">Multilingual Digital Platform</a>, and both national and&nbsp;<a href="https://futureu.europa.eu/assemblies/citizens-panels" target="_blank" class=" eac-external-link">European Citizens' Panels</a>. These contributions feed into the&nbsp;<a href="https://futureu.europa.eu/pages/plenary" target="_blank" class=" eac-external-link">Conference Plenaries</a>.</p>

<p>The Conference&nbsp;offers a new public forum for an open, inclusive, and transparent debate with citizens around a number of key priorities and challenges.</p>

<h2><strong>How can you participate?</strong></h2>

<ul>
	<li><!--[if !supportLists]--><!--[endif]--><a href="https://futureu.europa.eu/processes?locale=en&amp;pk_source=pdf_document&amp;pk_medium=link&amp;pk_campaign=europarl" target="_blank" class=" eac-external-link">share your own ideas or support others’ ideas</a> on the multilingual digital Conference platform</li>
	<li><!--[if !supportLists]--><!--[endif]-->organise your own events and promote it by adding them to the <a href="https://futureu.europa.eu/?locale=en&amp;pk_source=pdf_document&amp;pk_medium=link&amp;pk_campaign=europarl" target="_blank" class=" eac-external-link">Conference platform</a></li>
	<li><!--[if !supportLists]--><!--[endif]-->take a look at the <a href="https://futureu.europa.eu/meetings" target="_blank" class=" eac-external-link">events organised by people across the EU</a></li>
</ul>

<h2><strong>What will the outcome be?</strong></h2>

<p>All of the ideas gathered and reports on events are published on the platform openly and transparently. These reports will then directly influence the discussions in the European Citizens’ Panels as well as in the Plenaries, where citizens will enter into a dialogue with national and European decision makers.</p>

<p>By spring 2022, the Conference will provide guidance on the future of Europe to the European institutions</p>

<p><a href="https://futureu.europa.eu/pages/getinvolved" target="_blank" class=" eac-external-link">Get involved and make your voice heard when it comes to education, culture, youth, sport, and more</a>.</p>

<p>Follow on Twitter at&nbsp;</p>

Mandatory Expertise – Bitte vor der Bewerbung lesen

Für ein langfristiges SAP S/4HANA-Transformationsprogramm bei einem großen deutschen Unternehmen suchen wir einen erfahrenen Senior SAP Interface Cutover Lead.

Im Rahmen der Transformation von SAP ECC auf SAP S/4HANA müssen rund 800 Schnittstellen zwischen SAP- und Non-SAP-Systemen koordiniert und im Zuge des Cutovers in die neue Systemlandschaft überführt werden. Ein Großteil der erforderlichen technischen Anpassungen wurde bereits umgesetzt.

Gesucht wird ein erfahrener Experte, der den gesamten Schnittstellen-Workstream im Cutover eigenverantwortlich plant, koordiniert und steuert.

Drei zwingende Anforderungen:

  1. SAP Interface Cutover Management: Nachweisbare persönliche Verantwortung für die Planung und Durchführung eines schnittstellenbezogenen Cutovers innerhalb komplexer SAP-Transformations-, Migrations- oder Carve-out-Projekte.

  2. Technisches Schnittstellenverständnis: Fundiertes Verständnis von SAP- und Non-SAP-Integrationen, Schnittstellenabhängigkeiten, Middleware-Technologien sowie der Deaktivierung, Umschaltung, Aktivierung und Validierung von Schnittstellen.

  3. Eigenverantwortliche Steuerung: Erfahrung in der Koordination technischer Teams, externer Dienstleister und verschiedener Stakeholder innerhalb großer Transformationsprogramme.

Es handelt sich nicht um eine reine SAP-Cutover-Management-Rolle, eine klassische Datenmigrationsrolle oder eine Schnittstellenentwicklerposition. Entscheidend ist die Kombination aus Cutover Management, technischer Integrationskompetenz und eigenverantwortlicher Workstream-Steuerung.

Tasks

  • Enge Abstimmung des Interface-Cutover-Plans mit dem übergeordneten Cutover Management und weiteren relevanten Workstreams.

  • Identifikation und Bewertung technischer und fachlicher Abhängigkeiten zwischen Schnittstellen, Anwendungen und Systemen.

  • Planung und Koordination der schnittstellenbezogenen Aktivitäten im Rahmen von Cutover-Rehearsals und produktiven Cutover-Phasen.

  • Steuerung der Deaktivierung, Umschaltung, Aktivierung, Validierung und des kontrollierten Wiederanlaufs von Schnittstellen.

  • Identifikation, Bewertung und proaktive Steuerung von Risiken, Abhängigkeiten und kritischen Pfaden.

About the team

You'll join the Sell Online Tribe, the group shaping how merchants bring their businesses to life online. We design and build tools that help millions of entrepreneurs, from barbers to bakers, sell their products and services anywhere.

You'll be working on some of SumUp's biggest merchant-facing online products as part of the Bifrost team, contributing to growing and scaling critical products like Payment Links and Gift Cards, while also working on integration products that provide essential features used across many other SumUp products. They're high-traffic, high-responsibility products that other SumUp teams depend on too.

You'll join a small, cross-functional team and take on genuine ownership of the frontend - not just executing tickets, but shaping how the products evolve. With new features to ship and integration products to keep secure and current, there's real, meaningful work to get stuck into from day one.

What you'll do

  • Build and maintain frontend features across payment links, gift cards, and online checkout products, writing clean, testable, and maintainable code
  • Contribute to the development and upkeep of our integration products and SDKs, used by both internal teams and external partners
  • Take part in technical planning, design reviews, and sprint ceremonies - bringing your perspective on estimations, trade-offs, and improvements
  • Help reduce tech debt and improve application performance, observability, and accessibility as a foundation for future delivery
  • Monitor live services and respond to issues, providing redundancy for customer support requests reaching the team

You'll be great for this role if…

  • You have 5+ years of experience in TypeScript and JavaScript, with hands-on experience building production-grade React and Next.js applications (including SSR and app router patterns)
  • You have experience writing unit, integration, and end-to-end tests using tools like Jest, Vitest, or React Testing Library
  • You're comfortable working within CI/CD workflows and collaborating in agile environments (Scrum or Kanban)
  • You have experience with UI libraries such as Radix or shadcn, and a solid understanding of accessibility and UX best practices
  • You have a product mindset - someone who cares about the value delivered to merchants, not just the code written to get there, and who can work autonomously to drive complex features end-to-end

Why you should join SumUp

🌎 Opportunity to work in a truly global, multicultural team from our open, vibrant Cologne office, located in the heart of the city. This involves an office-first setup

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education

🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days

🚗 Commute made easy: subsidised mobility options like discounted transport tickets or bike leasing

💪 Stay active: access to fitness via Urban Sports Club, mostly covered by SumUp

💰 Financial health: a corporate pension scheme with SumUp contributing an extra 20% on top of your contribution

🎁 Employee perks: get discounts across products and services via our Corporate Benefits platform

🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service

🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

About SumUp

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.

SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. 

Hawk builds AI-powered financial crime detection (AML, transaction monitoring, and fraud prevention) for global tier-1 banks, payment processors, and high-growth fintechs. Because our platform analyzes real-time payment streams and sensitive financial data, security is not an administrative support function—it is our primary product promise.

We are looking for a technically grounded, hands-on CISO to own our global security posture end-to-end. This is a true player-coach leadership role. You will lead a dedicated team of four domain specialists while staying close enough to the technology to review cloud architecture, triage high-severity vulnerabilities, command critical incident responses first-hand, and debate technical security controls peer-to-peer with customer bank CISOs.

Why This Role Matters

  • Global Regulatory Scrutiny at Scale: We operate across key financial hubs including Germany, the UK, the US, Singapore, and a growing roster of international markets. With DORA enforceable across the EU and heightened ICT risk rules globally, our banking clients expect documented operational resilience, continuous testing, and verified controls across all jurisdictions.

  • Modern Attack Surfaces & Supply Chain Threats: Our multi-tenant and single-tenant cloud environments (AWS/GCP) process massive transaction throughput. Alongside defending against emerging supply chain vulnerabilities—from open-source dependencies to third-party build pipelines—you will need to deeply understand our AI approach and actively help harden our tooling, harnesses, and pipelines.

  • Enterprise Deal Velocity: Enterprise security reviews can either stall deals or close them. You will partner with our commercial teams to turn security questionnaires, risk mitigation, and architecture audits into enterprise trust and closed contracts.

Organizational Structure: The Four Domains

You will lead, mentor, and set technical direction for four specialized functional areas:

  1. Application Security: Secure SDLC, automated CI/CD security gates (SAST/DAST/SCA), software supply chain defense, secure coding standards, AI harnesses and pipeline hardening.

  2. Corporate Security: Zero Trust architecture, IAM/SSO, distributed endpoint defense (EDR/XDR), threat hunting, infrastructure access.

  3. Compliance & Governance: DORA implementation, ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), multi-jurisdiction regulatory audits, risk registry ownership.

  4. Data Protection: Solely dedicated to data protection: GDPR compliance, privacy governance, data subject rights, and statutory privacy regulatory requirements.

Core Accountabilities

1. Hands-On Technical Leadership, Engineering Integration & AI Hardening

  • Secure Coding Standards & SDLC: Establish and enforce secure coding baselines directly within engineering workflows. Ensure automated vulnerability scanning, SBOM tracking, and security gates are integrated into GitHub/GitLab CI/CD pipelines.

  • Software Supply Chain Defense: Protect build systems, dependencies, and deployment pipelines against supply chain tampering, compromised packages, and upstream vulnerabilities.

  • AI Tooling & Pipeline Hardening: Deeply understand our AI approach and work closely with engineering to harden our systems. Personally evaluate and implement protective mechanisms—including secure AI harnesses, container sandboxing, and runtime guardrails around AI tooling and workflows.

  • Vulnerability Lifecycle Management: Set strict remediation SLAs for CVEs and cloud misconfigurations. Directly arbitrate vulnerability severity, triage zero-days, and collaborate with engineering leads to ensure rapid remediation without stalling release velocity.

  • Zero Trust & Cloud Infrastructure: Architect and drive our group-wide Zero Trust roadmap across AWS and GCP environments, enforcing least-privilege IAM policies, network micro-segmentation, and secure developer access.

2. Commercial Trust & Customer Engagement

  • Peer-to-Peer Customer Dialogue: Act as the senior technical authority in enterprise sales cycles, engaging directly with bank CISOs, InfoSec panels, and procurement leads to validate Hawk's architecture, threat models, and operational controls.

  • Accelerating Enterprise Deal Velocity: Modernize vendor due diligence by replacing reactive security questionnaires with standardized evidence packages, continuous compliance portals, and pre-packaged architectural audits that win customer confidence quickly.

  • Converting Security into a Value Driver: Turn our robust security baseline into a core sales differentiator, helping commercial teams demonstrate to prospect banks why Hawk's defense posture makes us their lowest-risk vendor.

3. Risk Registry, Compliance & Governance Leadership

  • Company Risk Registry Ownership: Act as the executive owner of the company-wide Risk Registry. Go beyond cataloging risks: prioritize exposures dynamically, secure cross-functional executive buy-in to fund and execute mitigations, and transform risk management into concrete business enablement and revenue protection.

  • Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM): Oversee vendor risk tiering, supply chain vetting, and continuous monitoring for third-party vendors and cloud sub-processors, executed directly through the Compliance function.

  • Audit & Regulatory Leadership: Maintain existing ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II programs with zero major non-conformities across an expanding international perimeter.

  • DORA Implementation: Enforce end-to-end compliance with the EU Digital Operational Resilience Act—specifically ICT risk management, third-party vendor oversight, operational resilience testing, and ICT incident reporting.

  • Multi-Jurisdiction Alignment: Adapt policies proactively to meet global financial standards across the EU, UK, US, Singapore, and upcoming expansion markets.

  • Executive & Board Reporting: Translate technical cyber risks into clear business metrics (KRIs, risk heat maps, burn-down rates) for the CEO and Board of Directors.

4. Frontline Incident Response & Operational Resilience

  • First-Hand Incident Commander: Serve as the hands-on incident commander during Sev-1/Sev-2 security incidents. Lead technical investigations, root-cause analyses, log forensics, and technical debriefs directly alongside your team.

  • Breach Notification & External Escalation: Direct regulator, law enforcement, and client communications within mandatory statutory windows under GDPR and DORA guidelines.

  • Testing & Tabletop Drills: Design and execute technical red team engagements, threat-led penetration tests (TLPT), and crisis simulations with both technical engineers and the executive board.

12-Month Success Metrics:

  1. Commercial Velocity: Enterprise bank security assessments clear with zero high-severity blockers, accelerating enterprise contract closures.

  2. Proactive Risk Registry: The company risk registry is fully operationalized with executive buy-in, systematically driving down enterprise risk while supporting business expansion.

  4. Engineering & AI Hardening: Software supply chain security controls, secure coding standards, and AI harness guard rails are fully integrated into engineering CI/CD workflows.

  5. Resilient Team Operations: The four-person security team executes with high autonomy, defined KPIs, and high cross-functional trust across the company.

  • Player-Coach Track Record: Demonstrated ability to manage and grow a small team of domain experts while personally reviewing technical configurations, auditing cloud policies, or investigating an alert.

    • Drive model efficiency and local deployability on consumer hardware via knowledge distillation, quantization, and runtime optimization without degrading grounding or reasoning accuracy.

As a Software Engineer, you will help us drive our products and processes forward. You will be able to excel in a fast-paced environment with short project timelines from conception to deployment.</p> <h3><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO </strong><strong><br></strong></h3> <ul> <li>Lead the development of our RaceWatch software for one or more motorsport series.</li> <li>Work with product managers and customers to design features and prioritise tasks.</li> <li>Identify ways to add innovative new features to the software.</li> <li>Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code.</li> <li>Contribute to code quality, organization, and best practices throughout     Vocca in a few words

    Vocca is an AI voice agent that answers 100% of the calls of medical centres. The patient calls, the AI books the appointment or answers the question, and the medical secretaries keep their time for the cases where a human is really needed.

    • $20M raised, with the founders of Alan and Datadog as investors

    • Close to 1 million calls a month going through the platform

    The problem

    Every medical centre has its own rules. Who can book what, with which practitioner, at what time, what to do with an urgent case at 6 pm. Today these rules live in prompts and in the heads of our ops team. Each new clinic takes hours of manual work, and the ops team is the bottleneck of our growth.

    We are building the platform that removes that bottleneck. A scenario engine where the behaviour of the agent is structured configuration, not free text. A self-serve onboarding where a clinic connects its software and sets itself up. A dashboard where the medical staff stop executing and start supervising: the agent handles the volume, humans check what matters.

    This is the difference between selling a service and selling a product. The long term vision is simple: a clinic signs, connects its software and is live within days, without a single developer involved. You would be building that.

    • The dashboard our clinics use all day. Fast, reliable and clean enough that a medical secretary prefers it to the phone. We take frontend quality seriously and follow a design system written in code.

    • Your features, end to end. From the spec with the ops team to production, and the fix when something breaks, with the reason it does not happen again.

    How we build

    • Experimental, not R&D. You test, you prove with data, you ship. Challenging a decision means coming back with a result, not a debate.

    • Ship, then fix the last 1%. We ship the version that works, then fix the last 1% when it shows up. With AI, this trade off is much cheaper than before. The judgment about what not to touch is yours.

    • AI, seriously. Agents in every workflow, Claude Max provided. A migration estimated at 3 months was done in 2 weeks.

    • Close to the field. Every change lands in front of more than 1,000 medical staff. You talk every day with the ops team that deploys clinics and the sales team that sells the product.

    TypeScript everywhere, backend and frontend (Node, monorepo), PostgreSQL, a design system written in code. We are migrating our last Python services to TypeScript over the coming months.

    • You stayed long enough somewhere to see a system live, break and get better, and you learned from it.

    About Us

    Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia.     About the role

    You will be the statutory Head of Internal Audit for Nubank's European entity and the primary Internal Audit point of contact for the local regulator. As Nubank builds its regulated European operation, independent assurance is what earns and keeps the trust of the regulator and the governance bodies — you own that from day one.

    This is not a role that supervises other people doing the work. It is a full hands-on, build-from-scratch role: for the first 12–18 months you will operate largely on your own, performing and leading the audits yourself, with the support of Nubank's global Internal Audit team and additional resources over time as the function matures. You'll report functionally into Nubank's global Internal Audit leadership, preserving Internal Audit's independence and maintaining direct access to the entity's Audit and Risk Committees.

    You will build a modern, data-driven audit function — one that leans on automation, analytics and AI rather than traditional checklist auditing — while partnering with a young, fast-scaling business where governance and controls are still being built. Your goal: stand up and run a credible Internal Audit function that gives the Committees and the local regulator confidence that Nubank is growing in a healthy, sustainable way.

    You'll be responsible for

    • Acting as the statutory Head of Internal Audit for the European entity, representing Internal Audit before the local regulator and reporting independently into Nubank's global Internal Audit leadership and the relevant Committees.

    • Owning the entity's Internal Audit universe and risk assessment — a dynamic view of key risks across products, digital asset initiatives, financial crime, governance and internal-control frameworks.

    • Designing and executing the audit plan, and coordinating closely with Nubank's global Internal Audit function and the hubs in Brazil, Mexico and Colombia.

    • Performing and leading end-to-end audits hands-on — not only scoping and coordinating fieldwork, but often running the testing yourself — covering fintech/digital banking products, digital assets and related infrastructure, AML/financial-crime obligations, and governance, risk and control frameworks.

    • Coordinating Internal Audit's contribution to supervisory interactions with the local regulator, being comfortable explaining clearly what Internal Audit does before any regulator, and proactively communicating emerging risks.

    • Engaging the governance bodies — Audit Committee and Risk Committee — with clear, concise, impact-oriented reporting.

    • Building trust-based relationships with local senior management and second-line risk/compliance partners, operating as a trusted challenger and advisor while preserving Internal Audit's independence.

    • Promoting the use of technology, data and AI in the audit work — continuous auditing routines, data analytics, AI-assisted testing and documentation — to increase coverage and enable predictive risk monitoring.

    • Acting as a culture carrier for Nubank's Internal Audit, keeping the local function fully integrated into the global audit vision and standards.

    • Over time, and consistent with business and regulatory needs, designing, building and leading an appropriately resourced Internal Audit function for the entity.

    Experience and background

    • A solid Internal Audit background in financial services (as an internal or external auditor); senior second-line/compliance profiles are welcome when grounded in prior Internal Audit experience.

    • Experience with the Swiss or European regulatory framework.

    • Meaningful experience in fintech or banking.

    • Experience engaging governance bodies, specifically Audit and Risk Committees.

    • Proven knowledge of fintech/digital-banking business models, AML/financial-crime controls and investigations, and traditional banking products and infrastructure.

    • High ownership and autonomy

    • A genuinely hands-on posture

    • A data-driven approach to audit: experience with data and analytics in audit or risk work; hands-on SQL/Python is a strong plus and a good signal of fit, and a strong appetite to work with data-driven testing is essential.

    Cultural openness and humility

    • Ability to analyze end-to-end processes and controls across finance, credit, payments, AML, information security, technology and governance, connecting the details to the overall risk profile.

    • Excellent written and verbal communication, explaining complex topics clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including regulators and senior executives.

    • Strong stakeholder management — influencing senior leaders, challenging constructively and building trust across the three lines of defense.

    • Experience with digital assets — crypto and stablecoins. (Digital-assets experience is a plus, not a requirement)

    • No specific certification is required (CIA, ACCA, CISA, etc. are welcome but not mandatory).

    Auditors sign their name to every conclusion. An agent can do the heavy lifting, but only if the auditor can see how each conclusion was reached and trace it back to its source.

    Agent Builder is where firms turn their own procedures into agents their whole team can run, in Alwin by DataSnipper, our agentic automation platform for audit and finance. Built well, an agent makes quality a property of the procedure, not of who happened to be staffed on the engagement.

    You'll own Agent Builder and the agents firms build with it. Your users are the people at firms who build agents, and the methodology and quality teams who approve them for client work.

    This is a technical PM role. You'll shape the harness each agent runs in: the context it sees, the tools it uses, and where a person reviews its work. You'll own the feedback loops that improve agents after release. You'll work as a peer to the Agent Builder engineering team, and with our Agent Runtime and Evals teams here in Amsterdam.

    About DataSnipper

    The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

    We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

    At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

    For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

    And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

    If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

    The problems you'll own

    • A firm's procedure must become a harness an agent can follow, with the right context, tools and review points

    • Models are non-deterministic, but audit work must be defensible: traceable, attributed and reviewed

    • A firm will only rely on an agent it can test, approve and trace

    • Reviewer feedback must make agents better, with the firm's approval and without anything reaching another client

    • Methodology, models and standards all change. Agents in use must keep up without breaking work in progress

    What you'll do

    • Own the Agent Builder strategy and roadmap, and make the trade-offs explicit

    • Design the harness with engineering: how context is assembled, how tools are defined and called, and where a person must review

    • Decide what builders control and what the platform sets, so agents can encode real methodology and stay consistent

    • Build the feedback loops: turn run traces and reviewer edits into eval cases, regression tests and changes the firm approves

    • Set the quality gates an agent must pass before release, and test every new model or methodology version before it reaches live work

    • Report agent quality with a stated method and sample

    • Prototype in code before you write specs. Then write short specs and decision memos that engineers can build from

    • Spend time with the firms that build and approve agents, and turn what our forward-deployed teams learn into product, not one-off fixes

    What you bring

    • A technical background: software, ML or infrastructure engineering, or several years as a technical PM on developer or AI platforms

    • Hands-on experience shipping agent systems in production: context and retrieval, tool calling, orchestration, structured outputs, retries and fallbacks

    • Eval practice: building datasets, calibrating LLM judges against human labels, offline and online evaluation, and regression testing across model versions

    • Observability for LLM systems: traces, cost and latency, and classifying failures so you fix causes, not symptoms

    • System design skills: schemas, versioning, permissions, event logs and APIs. You can read a design doc and challenge it

    • PM experience on a product that other people build on

    • Prototyping in code with AI tools as part of your normal work

    • Clear, short writing

    What sets you apart

    • Audit or accounting knowledge, from practice or from building products for auditors, finance teams or other experts in regulated fields

    • Document AI: extraction, OCR, grounding and citation

    • You've built an agent harness or framework, eval tooling, or LLM observability

    • You've built review workflows or feedback pipelines that turn user corrections into eval or training data

    • Experience with low-code tools, workflow designers, rule engines or DSLs

    • Design-partner programmes with large enterprise customers

    What We Offer

    • Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact.

    • Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share in the company’s success and growth.

    • Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary.

    • 28 vacation days per year (full-time) to support your work-life balance.

    • Hybrid work model with at least 3 days onsite in our dynamic Amsterdam office.

    • Daily, freshly prepared lunches by our in-house chef to keep you energised.

    • NS business card for easy commuting to the office.

    • A structured onboarding programme designed to set you up for success, including dedicated time to learn our product and customers before you hit the ground running.

    • Access to continuous learning and development initiatives to grow your skills.

    • Engage with a vibrant international team spread across seven global offices.

    • Company-wide events like DataSnipper GO, where global teams come together.

    • Access to OpenUp, a mental health and wellness platform supporting your wellbeing.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

  • Fast execution, high ownership and strong attention to product quality.

Tech Stack

  • Kotlin

  • Android SDK

  • Coroutines & Flow

  • SQL / NoSQL

  • TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

  • Thinks in user journeys, not just screens.

  • Moves fast without creating messy code.

  • Notices UX, performance and reliability issues before users complain.

  • Honest about what they personally built, what was team-owned and what impact they can or cannot claim.

This Role Is Not For

Field Sales & Operations Representative

Full-time, Field-based (Mexico City, Mexico)

About Us

At The Global Talent Co., we provide opportunities to work with leading innovative technology companies worldwide, offering stable employment, competitive compensation, career growth, and access to a community of 25,000+ like-minded marketing professionals.

About the Company

You will be joining an early-stage program building a Mexico-based network of partner businesses that capture real-world workplace video data used to train AI models. The program is launching on the ground in Mexico City, and this is a foundational hire: the person who finds the right partners, gets them signed, and makes sure every location is set up to deliver.

The Role

As Field Sales & Operations Representative, you will own the partner pipeline in Mexico City from first visit to live location. This is not a sign-and-move-on sales role — you will scout and close partner businesses, then roll up your sleeves to onboard their teams, get the recording setup working, and keep each location delivering usable video consistently.

You'll work closely with the program lead and the operations team, splitting your time between in-person meetings with business owners and hands-on onboarding at partner sites. This role is ideal for a self-driven field seller with strong operational follow-through — someone who is energised by being out in the city, comfortable demoing technology in person, and happy to solve setup problems rather than hand them off.

Key Responsibilities

  • Scout and qualify businesses and locations across Mexico City, prioritising teams with 10+ employees

  • Build relationships with owners and managers and present the program in person

  • Negotiate agreements and manage follow-up through to contract signature

  • Coordinate partner onboarding: introduce the program to staff and demonstrate the recording setup

  • Train partner teams on headset and app usage so recording starts smoothly

  • Work with the operations team to get devices set up and resolve issues at each location

  • Stay close to partners after launch to ensure recording happens consistently and correctly, and that video is delivered as required

  • Manage multiple partner locations at once and keep the pipeline moving

Ideal Candidate

  • Field sales or business development experience selling to businesses in Mexico

  • Fluent Spanish and strong professional English (must)

  • Based in Mexico City, with the right to work in Mexico, and able to travel to partner locations across the city

  • Confident running in-person demos and negotiating agreements with business owners

  • Experience managing multiple accounts or locations at the same time

  • Strong operational follow-through — you fix setup problems, not just sign deals

  • Comfortable with technology and able to teach non-technical teams how to use new devices and apps

  • Self-starter who thrives in a fast-moving, early-stage environment with a performance-driven pay structure

Tools & Stack

Recording headsets, companion mobile app, CRM / pipeline tracking

Join Our Team Be part of a collaborative, innovative environment where your technical skills and product instincts can make a real impact. We offer competitive compensation, professional development opportunities, and a supportive work culture. Apply now and take the next step in your career.

At The Global Talent Co., our mission is to bridge the gap between leading global tech companies and amazing global talent. We believe everyone deserves equal access to opportunities, regardless of the country they happen to be born in.

<p></p>
<p><strong>Come join Karat's</strong> <a href="https://karat.com/candidates/interview-engineers/"><strong> </strong><strong>Interview Engineer</strong></a><strong> Community!</strong></p>
<p>Karat is always seeking talented engineers accross the world to join our Community. If you are interested in being considered for a future Interview Engineer opportunity, please submit your application to this posting.</p>
<h3>This is a <strong>contractor/freelancer</strong> opportunity, and work is compensated based on tasks performed once you complete onboarding. We hire worldwide and rotate which countries we recruit in. If you’re outside the U.S., check&nbsp;<a href="https://karat.com/become-an-interview-engineer/">our website</a> to see which countries are currently open, and apply there when your country is listed.</h3>
<hr>
<h3><strong>What Interview Engineers do:</strong></h3>
<p>Interview Engineers facilitate technical interviews with software developers around the world. As an Interview Engineer, you will create inclusive hiring processes by mitigating bias, improving hiring signals, and completing objective evaluations. These skills are critical to hiring and managing teams in startups and large enterprises. As a Karat Interview Engineer, you will:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Interview—</strong>Facilitate an interview through Karat's platform. Create an enjoyable candidate experience while you evaluate a candidate's fundamental coding skills and technical knowledge.</li>
<li><strong>Evaluate—</strong>Provide input on the candidate's performance, coding style, communication skills, knowledge question answers, and coding approach.</li>
<li><strong>Partner—</strong>Collaborate with Karat to test content, processes, and products.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>The experience you will bring:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>3+ years of experience as a Software Developer or Engineer</li>
<li>Excellent English communication skills (written and oral) with a high level of professionalism and interpersonal skills</li>
<li>Reliable access to a working webcam, microphone, and a stable Internet connection</li>
<li>Experience conducting technical interviews is preferred (e.g., data structures, algorithms)</li>
</ul>
<p>While we review your application, learn more about <a href="https://youtu.be/NBHfCPapm6I">life as an Interview Engineer</a> by watching this video!</p>
<hr>
<p></p>

      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> 8945 Cal Center Dr, Sacramento, CA 95826, USA
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://golden1.com">http://golden1.com</a>
</p>

<div>JOB TITLE: Web Applications Programmer II 
Department: IT – Digital Platform Delivery&nbsp;
STATUS: EXEMPT 
JOB CODE: 1711
PAY GRADE: 20S
PAY SCALE: $102,050.00 - $115,000.00 Annually
&nbsp;
LOCATION: Remote in CA only&nbsp;&nbsp;
GENERAL DESCRIPTION: 
The Web Applications Programmer is responsible for the programming and implementation of user interface, web service, and database applications for the external facing web site, employee Intranet and components that integrate third-party systems with our web applications and host system. 
&nbsp;
This position also establishes and maintains the organization's Internet and Intranet technical architecture and functions. The Web Applications Programmer will analyze, design, and implement technical solutions for existing and new Internet/Intranet system. In addition, they will make recommendations for best practices including the proper production, technical and design technique specific to Internet/Intranet programming and has experience and skill with dominant applications to maintain and modify the organization's Internet/Intranet efforts including content, graphical and communications. 
&nbsp;
TASKS, DUTIES, FUNCTIONS: 

Design, program and implement solutions programmed in .NET with attention to user experience and cross-browser support on both new and existing software projects. Requires working with other technical staff to understand platforms, integration points (APIs, services) and database structures.
Research, analyze, design, document, create test plans and prototype enterprise web applications and solutions that integrate with third-party systems.
Analyze, program, troubleshoot, debug, and implement enterprise web interface components using HTML, XHTML, XML, XSLT, JavaScript, ASP.NET, Visual C#.NET, SOAP, REST,jQuery, CSS, AJAX, JSON, and SQL.
Assist in managing all web programming including integration of approved content on the site, file management and site maintenance, database management, archiving, and record management.
Maintain a thorough understanding of state and federal laws and regulations related to credit union compliance including bank secrecy and anti-money laundering laws appropriate to the position.
Work with other members of the Web Applications and IT Programming teams to program enterprise wide applications and integrate them with third-party systems.
Responsible for interface programming and implementation and integration of web applications with backend databases.
Responsible for quality assurance of all e applications, including unit testing and source code control for versioning and lifecycle management.
Maintain knowledge of industry best practices, security standards and current technologies with regard to web programming, applying to all programming efforts.
Provide guidance to less experienced team members.

PHYSICAL SKILLS, ABILITIES, AND EXERTION UTILIZED IN THE PERFORMANCE OF THESE TASKS: 

Effective oral and written communication skills required to manage the implementation of web applications and solutions, prepare recommendations, perform analysis, and to accomplish other functions as listed.
Must possess sufficient manual dexterity to skillfully operate an on-line computer terminal and other standard office equipment, such as financial calculators, personal computer, facsimile machine and telephone.

ORGANIZATIONAL CONTACTS &amp; RELATIONSHIPS: 

INTERNAL:&nbsp;All levels of staff and management.
EXTERNAL:&nbsp;Vendors, sales personnel, members and peers at other financial institutions.

QUALIFICATIONS: 

EDUCATION: Bachelors in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
EXPERIENCE: Minimum 7 years’ experience in web development and maintenance. Minimum of 4 years .NET/C# experience. Minimum 1 year Sitecore experience.
KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS: Enterprise experience with Microsoft technologies (SQL Server, C#, WCF, ASP.NET, Entity Framework) and associated development environments (Visual Studio, TFS). Demonstrated expertise in developing, troubleshooting, and implementing software code that include at least the following: HTML, XHTML, XML, XSLT, JavaScript, SOAP, REST, jQuery, CSS, AJAX, JSON, and SQL. Must also have experience working with multi-tier software architecture, object oriented design, requirement gathering, Agile and Waterfall SDLC and have a thorough understanding of core systems infrastructure (operating systems, web server, database, etc.)

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Back-End Programming</category>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6696/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> New Jersey, USA
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://vertican.com">https://vertican.com</a>
</p>

<h2>About the role</h2>
<p>For 40 years Vertican has buildt software that runs law firms. One year ago we created a new modern AI platform for document automation (processing/extraction/redacting) which our customers have been adopting faster than any product we've ever had. Our suite of AI-enabled products save customers thousands of hours each week by processing high volumes of documents with precision and speed.The AI team is growing and we'd like you to join.</p>
<p>We are hiring an engineer to own the document processing pipelines end to end: design, benchmarking, experimenting with new architectures and tools, threshold required for deploying a new pipeline, etc.</p>
<p>We believe it's important to build our own tooling to help us run, improve, and measure our applications. Therefore, the ideal candidate thinks outside the box on how to not just build the product/pipeline, but also the tooling needed around it.</p>
<p>You will be the first dedicated ML hire on the product taking over from the engineering manager who build the current solution and will work directly with the founding engineering team.</p>
<p>This is a senior, hands-on individual-contributor role, but we are small team and you'll be involved in design, planning, roadmapping, and architectural decisions.</p>
<h2>What you will do</h2>
<p><strong>Design the pipelines.</strong> Own the architecture of the extraction-to-posting pipelines: page classification, field extraction, candidate retrieval, claim matching, confidence gating and the hand-off to human review, etc. Decide where rules end and models begin, and what each stage must guarantee to the next, what the separation of concerns are, etc.</p>
<p>We have different pipelines for different document types and expect that at any given point in time we may have new ones emerge and may consolidate others.</p>
<p><strong>Evaluate new systems before we adopt them.</strong> Run structured trials of candidate components and recommend what to keep. Examples include probabilistic record linkage (Splink), Azure AI Content Understanding and Document Intelligence, Azure OpenAI and Foundry-hosted models, and LLM agents with tools. Similarly, test new models with the existing pipeline as they are relased from the frontier labs.</p>
<p><strong>Build the evaluation process.</strong> You'll own the process of evaluating false positives, false negatives, errors of ommission, etc, that we ultimately use to determine if we should upgrade the pipeline.&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Ship and operate.</strong> Take components from trial to production in our python workers on the cloud, instrument them, watch cost and quota, and diagnose the cases reviewers send back.</p>
<p><strong>Set direction.</strong> Work with leadereship on the planing for accuracy, cost improvement, and overall product improvements.</p>
<h2>What we are looking for</h2>
<p><strong>Required</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>6+ years building ML or data-intensive systems, at least 3 of them owning a production pipeline whose output people acted on.</li>
<li>Solid backend engineering understanding and ideally cloud architecture understanding.</li>
<li>Ideally hands-on experience with document understanding: OCR or layout models, field extraction from scanned PDFs, or intelligent document processing products.</li>
<li>Experience with entity resolution or record linkage at scale (Splink, Dedupe, Zingg, or your own blocking-and-scoring system) against databases of hundreds of thousands of rows.</li>
<li>You have designed an evaluation from scratch: built a labeled ground-truth set, chosen the metrics, and defended a threshold to a non-technical stakeholder.</li>
<li>Production experience with LLM APIs, including structured output, tool calling and cost or rate-limit management; you can say when an LLM is the wrong tool.</li>
<li>Strong Python and SQL. Comfortable reading Postgres query plans and writing the raw query when the ORM gets in the way.</li>
<li>Engineering/Scientist mindset: you are scientific about testing the pipeline and how results are interpeted/presented.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Nice to have</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Azure AI services (Content Understanding, Document Intelligence, Azure OpenAI, Foundry) or the AWS and GCP equivalents.</li>
<li>Financial document processing: checks, remittance advices, lockbox files, payment matching, or accounts receivable automation.</li>
<li>Exposure to collections, legal operations or other regulated workflows handling PII.</li>
<li>Probabilistic matching theory (Fellegi-Sunter) or active-learning labeling workflows.</li>
<li>Experience building human-review tooling or feedback loops that feed back into training and evaluation data.</li>
</ul>
<h2>How we work and what we offer</h2>
<p>Small team, direct access to large datasets, weekly planning, daily standup, everyone remote in US timezones.</p>
<p>What we offer:</p>
<ul>
<li>A small team of tight-knit, like-minded people passionate about high quality software</li>
<li>Competitive compensation, commensurate with a senior individual-contributor role.</li>
<li>Monthly payments in USD</li>
</ul>
<p>Vertican is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on merit and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status.</p>

<p>Overview</p><p>A fast-growing AI evaluation company is building expert-level benchmarks that test how well AI agents handle real professional work in the terminal. We are hiring cryptography experts to turn real, paid tasks from their own work into end-to-end challenges for AI agents, each with a working solution and a check that proves the result is correct.</p><p>***THIS IS A TASK BASED COMPENSATION MODEL. PLEASE CHECK THE APPLICATION QUESTIONS FOR MORE DETAILS.***</p><p>Responsibilities</p><p>• Design expert-level Terminal-Bench cryptography tasks by turning real, paid work from your own experience into challenges that an AI agent must solve end to end.</p><p>• Define the task environment, including files, systems, ciphertexts and data, so the challenge is realistic, self-contained and reproducible in a Linux command-line setup.</p><p>• Write a working reference solution in Python or SageMath that proves the task is solvable, for example by recovering a key or decrypting a secret.</p><p>• Build automated checks and tests that objectively verify the final result is correct, and explain how a mistake or a partial answer would be detected.</p><p>• Calibrate task difficulty so a typical expert needs about 60-75 minutes to solve it, keeping it hard for AI agents while still fair and unambiguous.</p><p>• Package each task with Docker and Git where applicable, document instructions clearly, and revise based on reviewer feedback until it meets the required quality bar.</p><p>Skills/Experience</p><p>• 3+ years of hands-on cryptanalysis or applied cryptography; GRC, audit-only, policy, sales or management roles do not count, nor does coursework only</p><p>• Did the work in the last 3 years and can name the systems, tools, data and rules used</p><p>• Uses the low-level tools of the subfield, such as SageMath and Python, and works comfortably on the Linux command line</p><p>• Can show how a finding is proven, such as a decrypted secret or a recovered key, and explain how a mistake would be caught</p><p>• Technical fluency with files, CSV/JSON, APIs or databases</p><p>• Available to start around November 2026</p><p>Nice-to-have</p><p>• Published write-ups or research on cryptanalysis</p><p>• Strong CTF results, especially in crypto categories</p><p>• CVEs discovered in cryptographic implementations</p><p>• Experience with Docker, Git and writing automated tests</p><p>• Proficiency in C for low-level cryptographic work</p><p>Process</p><p>• Task vetting: complete a vetting task instead of a live interview</p><p>• Work is paid per task, with each task taking roughly 60-75 minutes</p><p>• Expected start around early November 2026</p>

      <region>USA Only</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> 
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://cmswa.com">http://cmswa.com</a>
</p>

<div><p>Custom Mechanical Solutions delivers energy-efficient HVAC systems across the Pacific Northwest, with deep expertise in healthcare, education, data centers, and retrofit projects. We work with top manufacturers to meet performance and sustainability goals—always focused on quality, care, and progress.</p>
<p>If you're ready to grow your career, we’re glad you found us. At CMS, you’ll join a team that supports your development and gives you space to make an impact. &nbsp;We review every application carefully and appreciate your interest in growing your career with our team.</p></div><h2>About Custom Mechanical Solutions</h2>
<p>Custom Mechanical Solutions (CMS) provides commercial HVAC equipment and technical solutions for complex building applications. We partner with contractors, engineers, building owners, and manufacturers throughout the equipment lifecycle—from system design and delivery through startup, troubleshooting, and field support.</p>
<p>As part of the Meriton family of companies, CMS maintains its specialized technical expertise and customer-focused approach while benefiting from the resources and long-term investment of a growing national organization.</p>
<p><strong>Title:</strong> Quality &amp; Reliability Engineer<br><strong>Department:</strong> CMS National Accounts<br><strong>Location:</strong> Fully remote within the United States<br><strong>Travel:</strong> Approximately 10–20% domestic and international travel</p>
<p><strong>Turn field challenges into better products, stronger processes, and more reliable outcomes.</strong></p>
<p>Join a growing National Accounts team where your technical judgment, curiosity, and follow-through will connect the jobsite to the factory and help shape how quality is managed as the business scales.</p>
<h1>The opportunity</h1>
<p>CMS is looking for a Quality &amp; Reliability Engineer to own and continuously improve the field-to-factory quality feedback loop for custom commercial and industrial HVAC equipment. You will lead technical investigations, turn incomplete field information into clear problem statements, and keep root-cause and corrective-action work moving through verified closure.</p>
<p>This is a hands-on, highly collaborative role. You will work across field operations, project teams, customers, engineering, manufacturing, suppliers, and factory quality leaders. Your work will help teams respond faster, create repeatable repairs, reduce recurrence, and apply lessons learned to future projects.</p>
<p>Work from where you are. This is a fully remote position that can be based anywhere within the United States. Approximately 10-20% domestic and international travel is expected, including travel to customer sites and manufacturing facilities in Mexico. Travel may be heavier initially while you build relationships with key stakeholders and learn the factory systems. Travel to Mexico is generally expected up to four times per year to support investigations, gather technical evidence, collaborate with factory teams, and validate corrective actions.</p>
<h1>What you will own</h1>
<ul>
<li><strong>Lead field-to-factory investigations. </strong>Coordinate quality issues from initial report through containment, root cause, corrective action, and verified closure.</li>
<li><strong>Turn field intelligence into action. </strong>Gather the technical evidence needed for faster decisions and translate recurring trends into improvements in design, manufacturing, supplier controls, installation guidance, training, and documentation.</li>
<li><strong>Create field-ready solutions. </strong>Develop clear, controlled Field Service Bulletins with approved repair steps, safety requirements, acceptance criteria, and closeout evidence.</li>
<li><strong>Drive clarity and accountability. </strong>Keep owners, milestones, risks, decisions, and overdue actions visible. Remove blockers and escalate high-impact or aging issues when needed.</li>
<li><strong>Use data to improve the program. </strong>Maintain quality dashboards and reports, identify systemic trends and emerging risks, and provide concise updates to leadership, project teams, customers, and factory partners.</li>
<li><strong>Go where the evidence is. </strong>Travel to customer sites and manufacturing facilities in Mexico to inspect equipment, support troubleshooting, gather evidence, collaborate with factory teams, and validate repair effectiveness.</li>
</ul>
<h1>You will probably love this role if...</h1>
<ul>
<li>When something fails, your first question is “Why?” and you keep digging until the evidence supports the answer.</li>
<li>You enjoy both the technical details and the bigger picture, from walking a jobsite and troubleshooting equipment to explaining the path forward clearly.</li>
<li>You take ownership without waiting for every step to be laid out, bring the right people together, and keep work moving until the issue is truly closed.</li>
<li>You are comfortable influencing across teams, even when you do not directly manage the people involved.</li>
<li>You want to help build and improve a quality program, not simply maintain one.</li>
</ul>
<h1>Required qualifications</h1>
<ul>
<li>A bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Manufacturing, or Quality Engineering, or an equivalent combination of technical education and relevant professional experience.</li>
<li>At least three years of relevant experience in manufacturing quality, field service, commissioning, reliability engineering, technical investigations, or related technical project support.</li>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Knock is redefining the home buying and selling experience, and we’re only getting started! <p>We bring that mindset into the work we do every day.&nbsp; The Knock Bridge Loan™ empowers homebuyers to ‘buy before they sell’, by unlocking the equity in their current home, giving them greater convenience, certainty, and competitiveness.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Founded in 2015, Knock has grown into a trusted partner for thousands of homebuyers and a network of 60,000+ loan officers and agents across the country. Backed by top investors like Foundry Group, Trinity Capital, and the National Association of Realtors, we’ve built a reputation for innovation and trust, earning 900+ five-star Zillow and Trustpilot reviews and an A+ BBB rating.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Join our growing team and help shape the future of homebuying! To learn more, visit <a href="http://knock.com/">Knock.com</a></p></div><p><strong>Lending Manager (Front End)</strong></p>

<p><strong>Knock is looking for an experienced mortgage leader to manage and grow our team of fully remote Loan Assistants. You’re approachable, open-minded, and adaptable. You know the work well enough to coach it and you’re willing to jump in and help. In this role you’ll own the Loan Assistant and post-closing pipelines, develop your team, and work with the Director of Lending Operations to make our processes better.</strong></p>
<p><strong>What you’ll do:</strong></p>

<li><strong>Mentor people inside and outside your team, and keep learning yourself.</strong></li>
<li><strong>Document conversations in our HRIS and build a sense of ownership across the team.</strong></li>
</ul>
<p><strong><em>Own the pipeline</em></strong></p>
<ul>

<li><strong>Coach the team and give feedback along the way.Balance workloads across the team to meet company SLAs.</strong></li>
<li><strong>Support post-closing review. </strong></li>
<li><strong>Work loans that have findings with the team member responsible and get them resolved.</strong></li>
<li><strong>Work closely with Sales, Underwriting, and Closing to give everyone timely, accurate service.</strong></li>
<li><strong>Compile team scorecard data each quarter to track KPIs and quality.</strong></li>
</ul>
<p><strong><em>Improve how we work</em></strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Help the Director of Lending Operations find gaps in process and policy across the Loan Assistant and post-closing functions. </strong></li>
<li><strong>Write or update procedures for review, training, and rollout, then follow up to make sure the changes stick.</strong></li>
<li><strong>Set best practices and change the workflow when needed so the team runs efficiently and meets company KPIs.</strong></li>
<li><strong>Take on ad hoc projects and step in wherever your team needs support.</strong></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>At least 10 years of relevant mortgage experience, including 5 or more years directly managing a fully remote team</strong></li>
<li><strong>Experience managing mortgage loan processing and/or post-closing teams</strong></li>
<li><strong>A track record of coaching teams and helping them succeed</strong></li>
<li><strong>Working knowledge of federal, state, and local mortgage regulatory compliance</strong></li>
<li><strong>Strong written and virtual communication skills</strong></li>
<li><strong>You keep a distributed team aligned, engaged, and accountable using tools like Slack and video meetings</strong></li>

<li><strong>A commitment to diverse, equitable, and inclusive practices that support Knock’s values of making an impact, learning, putting people first, being open, and being courageous</strong></li>
<li><strong>High school diploma or equivalent experience</strong></li>

<p><strong>Physical Requirements:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Set up and constantly operate a computer</strong></li>
<li><strong>Communicate and exchange accurate information to others via telephone or internet video applications</strong></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>The candidate must be able to perform the essential functions of the job, with or without reasonable accommodation.</strong></p>
<p><strong>Our Compensation Philosophy: As a fully remote (U.S.-based) workforce, our goal is to ensure that all Knockstars are fairly compensated.&nbsp; Please note that the salary range information that follows is a good faith estimate for this position provided pursuant to the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act for Colorado applicants. </strong></p>

<p><strong>This job opening expires December 31, 2026.</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><div class="section page-centered">
